name: Distractible
description: The Distractible Podcast with Mark Fischbach, Wade Barnes, and Bob Muyskens is a space to have thoughtful discussions about funny, out there, or otherwise interesting stories from everyday life. Also an opportunity for three friends to remind each other they are not as smart as they think.

videos.title: The Burls [Bonus Episode]
videos.overview: Surprise! It's a Distractible bonus episode! This one's a classic Distractible bit from "the vault."

videos.title: PowerWash Pals: Wade [Bonus Episode]
videos.overview: Mark takes Wade through his first time playing PowerWash Simulator.

videos.title: PowerWash Pals: Bob [Bonus Episode]
videos.overview: Welcome to another PowerWash Pals Powerwashing Podcast. This time with another "and friend," Bob.

videos.title: PowerWash Pals: Tyler [Bonus Episode]
videos.overview: Is power washing a sport? Either way, the hosts of "Go! My Favorite Sport Team" get down and dirty, then clean in this new episode of PowerWash Pals.

videos.title: Bit's That Didn't Fit [Bonus Episode]
videos.overview: It's time to finally open up the Distractible Vault, and take a peak at some unused bits that never saw the light of day... until now.

videos.title: Lens Chats With Mark: Part One [Bonus Episode]
videos.overview: Take a seat with the dudes in Bob's living room and join this casual conversation about improv mishaps, 3D porn shows, and... (drumroll) Mark's lenses.

videos.title: Lens Chats With Mark: Part Two [Bonus Episode]
videos.overview: Hop back into Bob's living room as the dudes discuss Mark's new hobby, Wade's YouTuber secrets, and a whole lot of pee.

videos.title: Breaking News (Part One) [Bonus Episode]
videos.overview: We interrupt this usual podcast schedule to bring you some breaking news headlines. Let's go "live" in the studio with Mark, Bob, and Wade to get the hottest scoops.

videos.title: Breaking News (Part Two) [Bonus Episode]
videos.overview: What does Walmart, ramen, the amish, and CSI: Miami have in common? Find out in this important BREAKING NEWS episode "live" from the Distractible studio.

videos.title: Breaking News (Part Three) [Bonus Episode]
videos.overview: The stories just keep getting weirder in the Distractible NEWS HQ.

videos.title: We're Filthy Rich! [Bonus Episode]
videos.overview: Wyoming has come to save us all with it's rare earth elements! And get your bald caps ready, because Wade has a special message just for you.

videos.title: Mark Is A Visionary [Bonus Episode]
videos.overview: Mark uses his new Apple Vision Pro for what it was designed for: terrifying Facetimes and VR porn.

videos.title: Midfacemaxxing [Bonus Episode]
videos.overview: Hey Mark, why the long face? Maybe the internet has some wholesome and definitely not horrific answers.

videos.title: Best Of Wade: Part 1 (Compilation)
videos.overview: It's time once again to venture into "The Distractible Vault" to retrieve some of the most bald, car-less, and boat-loving moments of the King of Meat himself, Wade.

videos.title: Best Of Bob: Part 1 (Compilation)
videos.overview: If the "Distractible Vault" was a fridge, it would be stocked up with only the best bite-sized moments of our favorite dad, wordsmith, and mechanic, Bob.

videos.title: Best Of Mark: Part 1 (Compilation)
videos.overview: It's time to relax with a copy of Penthouse Forum and plate of cannolis, because this compilation is all about the moon man himself, Mark.

videos.title: Best of Henry (Compilation)
videos.overview: A compilation dedicated to some of Henry's most memorable mentions from the podcast. Rest In Peace, Henry.

videos.title: Best of Bald (Compilation)
videos.overview: No freak flags are flying around these parts, cause this is the baldest compilation in the wilderness!

videos.title: Best of P*ssed Off: Part 1 (Compilation)
videos.overview: You better hope the Distractible Vault is fireproof, because there's a whole lot of fiery fury building up in this compilation!

videos.title: Best of Unfair: Part 1 (Compilation)
videos.overview: The only word, besides bald, that has changed the trajectory of Distractible forever.

videos.title: Best of James (Compilation)
videos.overview: There's baby fever floating around The Distractible Vault as we share some highlights from the last few years of Bob raising his son, James.

videos.title: Worst Tech Issues (Compilation)
videos.overview: No need adjust your computer settings, this compilation features some the most memorable moments where things went wrong in all the right ways.

videos.title: Ghostly Moments (Compilation)
videos.overview: Don't look now, but that just might be a spooky new compilation staring back at you in the dark...

videos.title: Best of The Render Farm (Compilation)
videos.overview: E-I-E-I-Oh boy! It's a bountiful harvest in the Distractible Vault tonight, with a collection of Mark's updates on ol' bessy herself: The Render Farm!

videos.title: Wade's Worst House Issues (Compilation)
videos.overview: If this compilation proves anything, it's that the Curse Of The Drowned Man is still alive well (despite what certain Bald-Face liars may want to believe.)

videos.title: Best of "Guam" (Compilation)
videos.overview: PUT THIS COMPILATION IN GUAM!

videos.title: Hair
videos.overview: Today the guys discuss all things hair (and the lack there of)! They warn of the dangers of hair removal, explore the strange hair trends of ancient Greek statues, and discuss sci-fi scenarios where the elite harvest hair and organs from the less fortunate.

videos.title: Body Odor
videos.overview: Mark hosts while Wade and Bob one-up each other's concepts for eliminating body odor, debate the true number of human senses, and remember nostalgic aromas.

videos.title: Transportation
videos.overview: Mark hosts while Wade and Bob one-up each other's concepts for eliminating body odor, debate the true number of human senses, and remember nostalgic aromas.

videos.title: Camping
videos.overview: Mark recounts the legend of an insane creature from the Rocky Mountains. Bob explains how his formative kayaking trip almost ended like a horror movie, and Wade...well, Wade just does what Wade does...

videos.title: Fake Tech
videos.overview: Bob prompts a discussion about technology that blurs the lines of reality in this hilarious episode full of gadget scams, 00's game nostalgia, and if the mute button could exist for real life.

videos.title: Supernatural
videos.overview: Mark hosts as Bob and Wade trade scary stories. For Bob, it's a strange woman who catches children who stay out too late. For Wade, a true story about how the night after watching "Texas Chainsaw Massacre" may have been scarier than the movie itself!

videos.title: Bob's Fridge
videos.overview: Bob rages while telling a story about the disaster that was the installation of his new fridge, and the technicians behind it.

videos.title: Conventions
videos.overview: On this episode of the pod, the guys get nostalgic for conventions and all the good and bad that come with them. From notable failed attempts, to bizarre themes (like "pizza" and "baby"), to post-COVID predictions, conventions hold a special place in Mark, Bob, and Wade's hearts.

videos.title: Hold my Beer
videos.overview: Wade hosts as Mark and Bob share some classic "hold my beer" moments from their college days.

videos.title: Synchronicity
videos.overview: In front of a "live" Discord audience, the guys discuss synchronicities, déjà vu, mind-reading, and hive minds.

videos.title: Perfect Crime
videos.overview: Mark, Bob and Wade aim to answer the age old hypothetical question: "What is the perfect crime?".

videos.title: Kids are Stupid
videos.overview: The guys share stories about how dumb kids can be: from inventing stupid games, to playing with banned toys, and somehow making it through all of it without a scratch.

videos.title: Happy Funerals
videos.overview: Bob hosts, opening the floor for Mark and Wade to discuss what they want their funerals to be like.

videos.title: Future
videos.overview: This week, the guys talk about the future: expectations vs. reality. What did people in the past predict the future would be like? Were they accurate? The guys wonder if they too will be accurate if they attempt to do the same.

videos.title: How to make a Best Friend
videos.overview: The guys give absolutely the worst advice possible on how to make a best friend.

videos.title: On Sh*t Moments
videos.overview: The guys discuss their bathroom close calls. Expired meat and hospital visits included, underwear left behind

videos.title: How Dare You
videos.overview: Tough sports coaches, rude fast food customers, and criminals getting their comeuppance, the guys discuss all of their moments of revenge and defiance against those who dared to cross them.

videos.title: Dreams & Nightmares
videos.overview: The guys recount their night terrors, the first ones they remember having as well as the ones they still have today. They also explore how memory relates to dreams.

videos.title: King of Meat
videos.overview: Following the first ever tie in Distractible history, Mark and Bob attempt to share hosting responsibilities, while Wade regales in his tales of good and not so good eats.

videos.title: Life Plan
videos.overview: The guys discuss their life paths, including career goals, turning points and what job they'd have in a zombie apocalypse.

videos.title: Lies from Parents
videos.overview: From coffee stunting your growth, to gum staying in your stomach forever, the guys recall the lies their parents told them growing up and how they still affect them as adults.

videos.title: Dating Advice
videos.overview: Wade hosts as Bob shares the story of his movie theater dating scare, and Mark reminisces on the only dating idea he had in high school, or the lack thereof.

videos.title: Dangerous Coasters
videos.overview: The guys discuss crazy roller coasters and amusement park rides, as well as discuss what a hypothetical "euthanasia coaster" would consist of.

videos.title: I Was Wrong...
videos.overview: The spelling of certain words, sex ed miscommunications, examples of the Mandela Effect: the guys humbly admit when they were wrong...

videos.title: Fears & Fetishes
videos.overview: Sharks, stage fright, and snapping your legs like Joe Theismann. Today, the guys discuss their fears and whether or not the opposite of a fear is a fetish.

videos.title: Old Men
videos.overview: Let's face it: Mark, Bob and Wade are getting - up there.

videos.title: We Are All Going To Die
videos.overview: Birds falling from the sky, climate change, solar flares, Jeff Bezos... What will be humanity's ultimate demise?

videos.title: Young & Stupid
videos.overview: The guys discuss adolescent sneakiness, food revelations, and more Jeff Bezos!

videos.title: That One Guy
videos.overview: Campfire guitar guy, the gamer guy with a bad mic, Crypto Bros, Florida Man… you know, that guy. Which “guy” are our guys?

videos.title: Never Give Up
videos.overview: Mark shares the story of a pilot who crashed his plane seven times, inspiring Bob and Wade to find similar tales of perseverance despite ridiculous failure.

videos.title: Humanity Is Bad
videos.overview: Bob challenges Mark and Wade to prove that humanity is ultimately good.

videos.title: Christmas Gone Wrong
videos.overview: The guys dive into how disturbing and strange some holiday traditions really are.

videos.title: Failed Resolutions
videos.overview: Mark's bizarre sleeping schedule, Bob drinks an entire handle of vodka, and Wade is - jogging? The guys discuss self improvement and whether or not New Year's is overrated.

videos.title: The Perfect Meal
videos.overview: The guys discuss their cooking mishaps and oddly satisfying food creations.

videos.title: Cryptids Are Scary
videos.overview: Mark's late-night descent into the "distressingmemes" subreddit sparks discussion of scary stories, including Bob and Wade's favorite cryptids.

videos.title: Bad Habits
videos.overview: From nose picking to cigarette smoking, the guys start 2022 off by discussing their worst habits.

videos.title: Beware The Candy Uncle...
videos.overview: Inspired by the Stanford Marshmallow Experiment, Mark challenges Bob and Wade to brainstorm creative ways to keep kids from eating too much candy.

videos.title: Funniest Joke In The World
videos.overview: After reading an "official" list of the funniest jokes in the world and deciding they aren't that funny, Bob challenges Mark and Wade to find or make the funniest joke in the world, with Mark ultimately turning to AI for assistance.

videos.title: Waste Of Money
videos.overview: The guys trade stories about losing embarrassing amounts of money. From Craigslist scams to mobile games, yard sales and more.

videos.title: The Distractible Threesome
videos.overview: In honor of Valentine's Day, the guys show their devotion by answering The New York Times' "36 Questions that Lead to Love".

videos.title: The Worst Piece Of Sh*t Episode Ever
videos.overview: Bob hosts and absentmindedly goes over an entire topic that the guys have already discussed in an earlier episode, leading to him having a breakdown. Also, Wade's dogs are fine, thanks for asking.

videos.title: Criminally Subliminal
videos.overview: Love them or hate them, we live in a world of advertisements. The guys discuss nostalgic commercials, the psychology behind ads and how they approach recording their own ads for Distractible.

videos.title: Hill I Will Die On
videos.overview: Prepare for a lot of hot takes as the guys explore their own and argue about them.

videos.title: Pet Stories
videos.overview: The guys reminisce about hilarious and chaotic pet-related memories.

videos.title: Disappointing Our Parents
videos.overview: Quitting jobs, sneaking porn, having a run-in with the police, today the guys chat about times they upset their parents.

videos.title: Superstitions
videos.overview: Bob hosts while Wade reveals his secrets for the Cincinnati Bengals' future success in football, and Mark theorizes that human compulsions might come from a simulation.

videos.title: Self Confidence
videos.overview: Wade wonders where he and the guys got their confidence, while Mark and Bob share their tips for public speaking and dealing with self-doubt.

videos.title: We Die On Your Hills
videos.overview: Inspired by the guys' previous discussion about their own hot takes, they scour the Distractible subreddit in search of hills that the listeners will die on, and discuss whether or not they agree.

videos.title: Serotonin
videos.overview: From TikToks with bad auto-tune, to nostalgic educational computer games, the guys dive into what gives them a serotonin boost.

videos.title: Oh No, The Future UwU
videos.overview: The guys discuss fears of things yet to come, while Mark struggles to keep Wade on topic.

videos.title: Aliens Among Us
videos.overview: Does our solar system have a tenth planet? Are there really UFOs flying around earth? And what the hell is a tardigrade? The guys answer all these questions and more while discussing potential evidence for life elsewhere in the universe.

videos.title: So Bad It's Good
videos.overview: Junk food, the Scary Movie franchise, Slenderman, sometimes things are so bad they might just be good after all.

videos.title: Wade's Secret Words
videos.overview: In this new episode format, Judge Wade let's the listeners in on his secret points system, but leaves Mark and Bob in the dark as they struggle to collect as many points as they can.

videos.title: F*ck You Energy
videos.overview: The guys discuss times in their life where their pure rage and annoyance were transformed in the most interesting and productive of ways.

videos.title: We Got Screwed
videos.overview: Labyrinthian healthcare services, customer service "assistance", and unobserved restaurant reservations: the guys talk about specific times they've been screwed over by life.

videos.title: The Bobs & The Bees
videos.overview: In yet another classic episode revolving around Bob, Mark and Wade are assigned the responsibility of raising Bob throughout his childhood and teaching him important life lessons along the way, in their own ways.

videos.title: Who's The Worst
videos.overview: The guys play a game of "Morals or NO Morals" and end up focusing on the latter.

videos.title: Don't Laugh
videos.overview: Wade creates a new points system once again, pitting Mark's laughter against Bob's laughter.

videos.title: The Atrocities Of Summer
videos.overview: Bob and Wade trade stories about summer injuries, while Mark deviates into delusion.

videos.title: Anything Goes
videos.overview: Mark leaves things up to chance for Bob and Wade in this new game mode featuring a blaring alarm and randomly generated countdowns.

videos.title: Worst World Records
videos.overview: Bob shares the story of Sir Hugh Beaver, while Mark and Wade compete to find the most shocking and disturbing World Records.

videos.title: Conspiracy Theories
videos.overview: The Aladdin Exception, Ghost Kitchens, Edward Snowden and The NSA: the guys dive deep (but not too deep) into some of their favorite conspiracy theories.

videos.title: Before We Die
videos.overview: The boys play Hot or Not: Bucket List Edition, plus share some of their personal Bucket List items.

videos.title: The Boys Bet It All
videos.overview: Mark whips up a new timed game mode where Bob and Wade race to Google topics. The slower they take to find their topic, the more points they get deducted and added to the winners pot.

videos.title: Fast Food Tier List
videos.overview: The legendary Raising Cane's, the classic McDonald's, the scarce Fazoli's: see where the boys rank these and many other fast food spots.

videos.title: The Distractible Game Show
videos.overview: Bob prompts Mark and Wade to share their favorite game shows, then surprises them with his own game show for them to compete in.

videos.title: Bob Doesn't Know
videos.overview: Instead of dual hosting, Mark and Wade compete in a secret game of their own, leaving Bob in the dark.

videos.title: Go With Your Guy
videos.overview: Door-to-door salesman, house parties going too far, love at first sight: today the guys talk about the accuracy of their gut feelings.

videos.title: Musical Memories
videos.overview: First kisses, funny dances, going on stage: today the guys talk certain songs that transport them to specific life moments.

videos.title: Solving The Unsolvable
videos.overview: Why humans sleep, the creator of the universe, alien life: today the guys attempt to solve these great mysteries.

videos.title: Broken News
videos.overview: In the spirit of the Distractible Live episodes on the Distractible Youtube channel, Mark takes Bob and Wade through a variety of headlines and news articles. Riffing ensues.

videos.title: Video Game Tier List
videos.overview: Bob's hot take on Pokémon, Markiplier's true feelings on Five Nights at Freddy's, find out where the guys rank these games and more.

videos.title: Naked
videos.overview: The guys share awkward spa stories, then rank the best/worst places to be naked.

videos.title: The Bait Debate
videos.overview: Today the guys troll specific media fandoms by giving them hot take bait.

videos.title: Big Or Small
videos.overview: What is better, big or small? Today the guys decide once and for all by giving their personal opinions prompted by Bob's list of items.

videos.title: Change
videos.overview: Recorded live and with the guys in the same room for the first time in 5 years, today Wade throws it back to tour with a favorite improv game... CHANGE!

videos.title: Candy Tier List
videos.overview: Today the guys compile a contentious tier list about all different kinds of candy, just in time for Halloween.

videos.title: Devil's Advocate
videos.overview: Mark invites Bob and Wade to alternate playing the Devil's Advocate for a variety of agreed upon, and not so agreed upon social norms and behaviors.

videos.title: Would You Rather
videos.overview: Bob forces Mark and Wade to pick their poison, having to decide between several pairs of awful scenarios.

videos.title: Thank You
videos.overview: Today the guys celebrate Thanksgiving with genuine outpourings of gratitude, which Mark the host, of course, converts to numerical point values.

videos.title: I Tried So Hard And Got So Far But In The End It Didn't Even Matter
videos.overview: Today Bob's story of Google Glass inspires Mark and Wade to find great stories of failure in history.

videos.title: One Paw In The Grave
videos.overview: Wade's emotional roller coaster of a story takes center stage as he explains the strange coincidences surrounding a close call with his beloved cat. Oh, and Bob gives a fridge update.

videos.title: We're NOT Getting Old
videos.overview: Bob takes Mark and Wade through a list of strange, unorthodox and disgusting anti-aging methods to decide if the treatments are worthwhile.

videos.title: Don't Say Christmas
videos.overview: Wade's Secret Words is back, but this time there's only a single word in the game: Christmas.

videos.title: The Perfect Day
videos.overview: Bob and Wade derail Mark's profound and dedicated search for the perfect day upon which to base your life in the new year and beyond.

videos.title: Good Bad Habits
videos.overview: You know the guys are getting older, but now it's time they try to convince you their bad habits are actually good.

videos.title: You Member?
videos.overview: Bob gives an update on his newborn baby, James, then pivots the topic to memory. The guys then discuss some of their first memories and how they think memories actually work.

videos.title: The Ick
videos.overview: Inspired by a post from the official Distractible subreddit, the guys discuss things that give them the ever illusive, yet always unnerving "ick".

videos.title: Bob's Baby
videos.overview: In an episode that takes a more serious turn, Bob recounts the unexpected and emotionally taxing circumstances surrounding his son's birth, and how they affected him and his wife.

videos.title: Wade's Silly Choices
videos.overview: A major tone switch from the last episode, Wade is hosting and makes Mark and Bob talk through strange and hilarious scenarios. From having the worst super power imaginable, to living in a world ruled by clowns, and more.

videos.title: Friendship Test: Mark Edition
videos.overview: Who is the better friend? Today, Bob and Wade's friendship with Mark is put to the test via some Mark-based trivia.

videos.title: Profession Confessions
videos.overview: Bob hosts a conversation about uncomfortable job stories, embarking the guys on a wild trip down memory lane.

videos.title: The Masks We Wear
videos.overview: On a more serious note than normal, the guys discuss the metaphorical mask, which social situations we put our masks on for, and whether those masked versions of ourselves are really us.

videos.title: Distractible: The Musical
videos.overview: The guys star in an improvised musical about video games, news, or anything else that comes to mind.

videos.title: The Emmy Losing Episode
videos.overview: Another classic Wade episode with an excellent topic: making the perfect video game. Except it goes horribly wrong. Or does it? Because during today's conversation, no one can seem to agree on anything.

videos.title: Am I The Asshole?
videos.overview:
A special mid-week episode, today the guys celebrate their first VIDEO PODCAST (video available only on Spotify!), by digging through the r/AmItheAsshole reddit page!

P.S. New episodes will continue Mondays AND Fridays moving forward! Prepare to be doubly distracted...

videos.title: Good Advice?
videos.overview:
Heads or tales, good or bad, riddles or rhymes?!? Find out on today's episode... Also, Wade has Covid. 

P.S. Don't forget to look out for another new Distractible episode Friday! Episodes will release Mondays AND Fridays from now on!

videos.title: The Shoe Game
videos.overview: Mark and Wade are getting married?!? Well, not exactly, but Bob still wants them to get to know each other using a fun wedding shower game.

videos.title: The Fairest Episode Ever
videos.overview: Joking jokers joking about jokers and joker-ing each other's jokers... but, trust us, it's fair.

videos.title: Just Relax
videos.overview: If you can believe it, today the constantly distracted boys ~attempt~ to guide each other in some calming and vaguely focused meditations.

videos.title: Self Actualization
videos.overview: Today, supremely confident host, Wade, challenges contestants Mark and Bob to get vulnerable and talk about the insecurities around their achievements.

videos.title: Wonders Of Our World
videos.overview: Mark and Wade compete, pitching various monuments, achievements, and artifacts, hoping to make them onto Bob's list for the seven new wonders of ~their~ world.

videos.title: Video Game Tier List (Part 2)
videos.overview: Wade celebrates his birthday (sort of) by continuing the burls' video game tier list.

videos.title: Would You Rather (Part 2)
videos.overview: The dudes are back to continue where they left their all-telling game of Would You Rather.

videos.title: Our Firsts
videos.overview: Bob, Mark, and Wade reminisce, cringe, and sing about some of their first experiences.

videos.title: Wade's Questions
videos.overview: Much like his fashion sense, Wade's topic today is... just a random collection of things he threw together.

videos.title: Million Dollars, But...
videos.overview: Mark offers the guys 1 million dollars, but for weird consequences. The coin flip at the beginning? Nah, that's not important at all.

videos.title: Who's Better
videos.overview: Today, Mark and Wade die. Yes, you read that right. And Bob, the celestial arbiter, decides what becomes of them: the good place or the bad place?

videos.title: Riddles & Rhymes
videos.overview: Two hosts! One of them speaks in riddles, the other speaks in rhymes...

videos.title: Ohio Stuff
videos.overview: The boys talk Ohio like only true Ohioans can! Plus, another member of Distractible finds out they have ADHD.

videos.title: Bread
videos.overview: Wade gets a ~rise~ out of Mark and Bob by making them argue about bread.

videos.title: Three Peens In A Pod
videos.overview: Mark throws it back to the guys' old livestreaming format, Wade calls in from vacay, and Bob flips his lid... or should I say... doesn't?

videos.title: The Wheel Of Fate
videos.overview: A wheel, a random topic generator, and a timer: sounds like a Mark episode, doesn't it? Nope, somehow it's a Wade episode.

videos.title: Will You Press The Button?
videos.overview: You can shapeshift into anyone, EXCEPT yourself... You become the most beautiful person on earth, BUT you are only as smart as a 3rd grader... You get to be apart of your favorite movie, BUT you have to be the antagonist... Find out if the guys would press those buttons and say yes to these fun, funny, and occasionally dark scenarios.

videos.title: Hypocrisy?
videos.overview: The topic is hypocrisy and they barely talk about their hypocrisies??? Hypocrites!

videos.title: Artificial Intelligence
videos.overview: Today, the guys discuss the ramifications of recent updates in AI. Did ChatGPT write this, or is this something a human would say?

videos.title: What I Want
videos.overview: A lighter turn from last episode, today the dudes dive into what they hope the future holds for civilization 100 years from now.

videos.title: Bob Wins This Episode
videos.overview: The boys obsess over their current favorite gadgets, gizmos, and doodads.

videos.title: I'm Better
videos.overview: Xbox vs Playstation, LeBron vs Jordan, Skyline vs Gold Star... A lot of times, strong opinions can be silly, no matter how competitive or passionate people get about them.

videos.title: Listener Q&A
videos.overview: Today the topic is effectively chosen by YOU, the listeners and viewers! Will your personal question be answered? Listen to find out!

videos.title: I Wasn't Ready
videos.overview: College, customer service calls, pyramid schemes: today the guys discuss the things they weren't ready for when heading into adulthood.

videos.title: Rage
videos.overview: Mark urges the guys to dig deep and find moments in their past full of unbridled rage...

videos.title: Weird
videos.overview: Wade listing off some of Earth's most bizarre animals leads Bob and Mark to get weird in their own ways.

videos.title: Weird (Part 2)
videos.overview: Internet issues, Mark being chaotic, Wade being teased, and Bob talking about TikTok trends. Yeah... sounds like a weird, completely unique episode.

videos.title: Weird (Part 3)
videos.overview: But of course! The third member of the Distractible trifecta must also guide a chat about ~the weird~. This time, it's weird real estate.

videos.title: YouTubers For YouTubers
videos.overview: What YouTubers are ~our YouTubers~ subscribed to? Hear their niche and fascinating channel recommendations on today's show!

videos.title: It's Mark's Birthday
videos.overview: Today on Distractible, the guys find out how Mark's Birthday connects to their most profound moments of love.

videos.title: Whimsical Headlines
videos.overview: This is NOT Weird Part 4, I repeat, this is NOT Weird Part 4...

videos.title: I Quit (Part 1)
videos.overview: The guys are FINALLY back! But where have they been? Listen as Mark talks about his emotional adventure from the ER to South Korea, and Bob blames Wade on Twitter for the missing episodes. #blamewade

videos.title: You Ever Feel A Feel?
videos.overview: It's getting emotional up in here, as Wade hosts and asks the guys what films, music, and games hit them right in the feels.

videos.title: Microplastics Solved Forever
videos.overview: Guess what's probably lurking inside of you right now? That's right... Microplastics! Mark hosts as Bob & Wade go head to head in the ultimate debate of whether these tiny invaders are destroying or benefiting our planet.

videos.title: I Quit (Part 2)
videos.overview: We mean it this time. WE QUIT! Not really... but watch as Bob, Wade, and Mark share their spooky, dangerous, and embarrassing professions that made them decide to quit and move forward.

videos.title: Mac Vs. PC
videos.overview: The age old debate among computer users FINALLY gets addressed... which is better: Macs or PCs? Watch as Bob and Wade debate over which one of Mark's computers should be destroyed IMMEDIATELY.

videos.title: Reading
videos.overview: Reading? Reading books? Ever heard of it? Mark, Bob, and Wade definitely have. They do it all the time... For sure.

videos.title: Distractible Tier List
videos.overview: Wade singing songs, Bob becoming Guru Harold, Mark not being able to stop talking about AI: find out where the burls would rate the subreddit's favorite podcast bits!

videos.title: Aliens Among Us (Part 2)
